about_the_game:
Tin Lord is a post-apocalyptic RTS with tower defense elements, where you command the last robots on a destroyed planet. An ancient AI, created to save the ecosystem, awakens a century after the disaster... and sends a signal to the remaining machines. But can it be trusted?

In a world without people, robots fight mutants, reshape the landscape and restore forgotten technologies. Each mission is a delicate balance between building, defending and caring for the ecosystem.

Game Features:

  • Real-time strategy: Build your base, place turrets and defenses, manage resources and plan your moves.

  • Grim post-apocalyptic world: The game's landscape changes dynamically through the interaction of tiles.

  • Diverse Enemies: Fight monsters using the technologies you've learned.

  • Defensive structures: Build a variety of turrets from simple ballistas to powerful cannons and watch them destroy your enemies.

  • Ecology management: your actions affect the ecological state of the world, which adds additional complexity during the game.

Prepare for an intense strategic struggle for survival and world restoration, where every move you make could be decisive!
